scenarios.expected: Representative terms and limits in the reference match the app: fixed concepts are separate from configured labels, and role and file limits are accurate. Examples do not equate Entity with Counterparty, Task due dates with Key dates, or Comparison with Document Version.
scenarios.actual: 3 recorded steps passed for this role on 3fa407e3. The role control for a user offered only Administrator, Legal team member and Business user. Contract statuses showed the Stages Draft, Review, Approval, Signature, Active and Ended, and a new Matter status asked for Category Open or Closed; Cancel changed nothing. A Confidential Entity answered "Entity not found" without a Grant, opened with one, and was refused again after removal. A Confidential Contract without named access answered "Contract not found". The Administrator's Document actions included Delete, and the Legal Team Member's did not.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the source-review author; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.

The lab Help and formal readers serve the article bytes committed at 3fa407e3, which differ from the reviewed corrected bytes. Steps followed the reviewed bytes against the app. Reader checks prove the routes, headings and UI behavior; link checks opened every internal link of the reviewed bytes in the bundled formal reader.
The admin lab is shared with other DOC-029 agents. The walkthrough created only records named DOC-029 support ... and changed no organisation settings.

Two earlier recorded attempts (walkthrough-r1-attempt1.json, walkthrough-r1-attempt2.json) each had one reviewer harness fault and are kept with their disposition. Exploratory probes and development runs before them are not evidence.

Representative terms were compared with the app; Holding, Registration, Officer, Obligation, Signer, Envelope, Comparison and Generated redline rows were checked in the article text only, not exercised in this walkthrough.
Word/PowerPoint conversion and PDF OCR were not exercised here; the Document reading groups verify them.

compatibilityReview.summary: From 3fa407e3 to 57e77e38, round 2 (DOC-029r2 compatibility reviewer (support)) found the article compatible: I inspected the app diff from 3fa407e3 to 57e77e38 and found no change to roles, access scopes, Stages, Key dates, Documents, the upload limit or file reading; the new 5 MB limit is for the organization logo only. I replayed the round 1 V-C50 walkthrough on the admin2 lab and all 11 steps passed. From 57e77e38 to 432dba3a, round 3 found only apps/web/src/routes/welcome.tsx and its test changed. The wizard now goes to /auth/two-factor/enroll after it saves a policy that requires two-factor authentication. Read the article. It makes no statement about the wizard Authentication step or two-factor enrollment.
